name: dot1dPortCapabilitiesTable
description: A table that contains capabilities information about every port that is associated with this bridge.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.1.4.1.1.name: dot1dBasePort
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.1.4.1.1.description: The port number of the port for which this entry contains bridge management information.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.6.1.1.4.1.1.name: dot1dPortCapabilities
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.6.1.1.4.1.1.description: Indicates the parts of IEEE 802.1D and 802.1Q that are optional on a per-port basis, that are implemented by this device, and that are manageable through this MIB. dot1qDot1qTagging(0), -- supports 802.1Q VLAN tagging of -- frames and GVRP. dot1qConfigurableAcceptableFrameTypes(1), -- allows modified values of -- dot1qPortAcceptableFrameTypes. dot1qIngressFiltering(2) -- supports the discarding of any -- frame received on a Port whose -- VLAN classification does not -- include that Port in its Member -- set.
